name: Houzuki Daichi
source:
An incredibly wealthy company president, he has recently learned that he's dying. Because his daughters [url=http://vndb.org/c12895]Kaede[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c12896]Sayaka[/url] remind him of his dead wife, he sometimes masturbates while thinking of them.

He is the protagonist of the common route and although sometimes rarely seen in individual routes he is still the main drive of all action.
